venue.zh: 温布利 / JFK 体育场（全球转播）

summary.en: Global charity broadcast. Many short sets; a few clips dominate memory.
summary.zh: 全球慈善转播。很多短场；记忆只留几段。

whyEpic.en: Live Aid mixes charity, satellite TV, and stadium craft. Many acts play; culture keeps a handful of minutes. This chronicle treats it as a hinge for rock as shared broadcast event—not as a streamable full day.
whyEpic.zh: Live Aid 混合慈善、卫星电视和体育馆手艺。很多人上台；文化只留几分钟。本编年史把它当摇滚成为共享转播事件的枢纽——不假装能播整天。

note.en: Many acts; public memory collapses to a few clips.
note.zh: 多队上场；公众记忆常坍成几段。

rightsNote.en: Broadcast rights are locked down. No full embeds here—seek official remasters.
rightsNote.zh: 转播权锁死。此处不嵌整场——请找官方重制。
